sections.heading: What is trending: “final fantasy vii revelation”
paragraphs: “final fantasy vii revelation” appeared on Google Trends' Trending Now list for US (snapshot taken 2026-09-03T18:38:03+00:00 UTC). Google reports at least 2,000 searches for this term — that figure is a lower bound published in the official Trends feed, not an exact count.

sections.heading: What's behind the spike — the coverage

list: “Final Fantasy VII Revelation launches on PS5 April 8, 2027” — PlayStation.Blog
“FACE THE LEGENDARY WEAPONS IN FINAL FANTASY VII REVELATION — NEW TRAILER UNVEILED AT GAMESCOM OPENING NIGHT LIVE” — Square Enix Press Hub

sections.heading: Timeline
paragraphs: The trend entry was published to the Google Trends feed at Thu, 3 Sep 2026 11:10:00 -0700. Our snapshot was taken at 2026-09-03T18:38:03+00:00 UTC and this briefing was assembled at 2026-09-03T18:39:34+00:00 UTC.

sections.heading: How to read these numbers
paragraphs: Google Trends reports approximate search volume as a lower bound (for example “20K+”). Actual volume can be significantly higher. Trending status reflects acceleration in searches, not the absolute size of a topic. For the full story behind the spike, read the cited coverage below — this briefing intentionally adds no speculation beyond the sourced facts.
